lowBandwidth.heading: Low-bandwidth mode
lowBandwidth.label: Data usage on this device
lowBandwidth.statusNetwork: Active — your browser or network reported Data Saver / a 2G-class connection.
lowBandwidth.statusUser: Active — enabled manually on this device.
lowBandwidth.statusOff: Not active — the app is using full quality.
lowBandwidth.effectsOn: While active: background polling slows to a quarter of its normal rate, entrance animations are disabled, charts render at most {{points}} points, satellite/terrain basemaps fall back to the lightest raster tiles, and the service worker stops storing new images and map tiles.
lowBandwidth.effectsOff: When active: polling slows down, animations stop, charts render fewer points, heavy basemaps fall back to light tiles, and the service worker stops caching new images and map tiles.
